items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very happy to have Tom Varner with me today.

ctx.x: Tom was interviewed via Zoom on August 13, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very happy to have Tom Varner with me today. I’m going to prioritize your introduction. I’m going to go with composer first, French hornist and music educator. How’s that?
That’s fine. And band leader too you did say, or ensemble leader, yeah.
